description: Evidence-scoped Test262 conformance, readiness, current fixture status and historical diagnostics. Operational signals use explicit unknown states; notifications are paused.

options.content:
## Current conformance requires a reporting target and trusted evidence
Each result below is scoped to a channel, evidence kind and provenance. **Native** results measure the native implementation; **MVP composite** results measure the composite pipeline and are reported separately.

Pass rate = fixtures with all required variants passing ÷ runnable fixtures. Missing, conflicting and failing results remain in that denominator. Excluded fixtures are shown separately, so this is scoped runnable conformance, not a claim that the entire Test262 suite passes.

**No current rows means conformance has not yet been established.** Historical observations are diagnostic evidence, not a current conformance score. Counts describe stored evidence; archive import completion is a separate check. Panels use the current snapshot, independent of the time picker.

panels.description: Authority state, not a conformance verdict.

targets.rawSql: SELECT deployment_state FROM test262_reporting.v_catalogue_summary WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Catalogue deployment state

panels.description: Stored trusted observations; a count alone does not establish conformance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT trusted_observations FROM test262_reporting.v_catalogue_summary WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Trusted observations

panels.description: Zero means no current reporting target is available.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS scopes FROM (SELECT DISTINCT channel,evidence_kind,provenance_id FROM test262_reporting.v_current_fixture_status WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring})) t

panels.title: Current report scopes

panels.description: Inventory includes exclusions; this is not the conformance denominator.

targets.rawSql: SELECT fixtures FROM test262_reporting.v_catalogue_summary WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Stored fixtures

panels.description: Separate denominators for each target. No result means no current conformance report. An empty denominator produces NULL, never a fabricated zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT channel,evidence_kind,provenance_id,corpus_id,count(*) AS inventory_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE eligibility='runnable' AND status <> 'metadata-error') AS runnable_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='complete-pass' AND eligibility='runnable') AS passing_fixtures,round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='complete-pass' AND eligibility='runnable') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE eligibility='runnable' AND status <> 'metadata-error'),0),2) AS runnable_pass_percent,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='fail') AS failing_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='incomplete') AS incomplete_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='conflicted') AS conflicted_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='excluded') AS excluded_fixtures,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='metadata-error') AS metadata_errors,max(last_received_at) AS last_evidence_at,max(target_updated_at) AS target_updated_at FROM test262_reporting.v_current_fixture_status WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY channel,evidence_kind,provenance_id,corpus_id ORDER BY channel,evidence_kind

panels.title: Current conformance by scope

panels.description: Includes exclusions, incomplete results, metadata errors and conflicts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT channel,evidence_kind,provenance_id,status,count(*) AS fixtures FROM test262_reporting.v_current_fixture_status WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY channel,evidence_kind,provenance_id,status ORDER BY channel,evidence_kind,status

panels.title: Current status breakdown

panels.description: First 500 fixtures; use status counts for totals.

targets.rawSql: SELECT channel,evidence_kind,provenance_id,upstream_path,status,eligibility,reason_codes,required_variant_count,recorded_variant_count,pass_variant_count,conflict_flag,last_received_at FROM test262_reporting.v_current_fixture_status WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring}) AND status IN ('fail','incomplete','conflicted','metadata-error') ORDER BY status,upstream_path LIMIT 500

panels.title: Current fixtures requiring attention

panels.description: Observation and fixture counts by provenance. Do not sum observed fixtures across outcomes or revisions to derive a suite pass rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT evidence_kind,trust_class,provenance_id,outcome,observations,observed_fixtures,last_received_at FROM test262_reporting.v_catalogue_outcomes WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring}) ORDER BY trust_class,evidence_kind,provenance_id,outcome LIMIT 500

panels.title: Historical outcomes — not current conformance

panels.description: Diagnostic evidence across stored provenances, including historical results; not restricted to current target.

targets.rawSql: SELECT evidence_kind,provenance_id,failure_class,phase,observed_error_type,attempt_count,fixture_count,representative_path,last_received_at FROM test262_reporting.v_failure_clusters WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring}) ORDER BY fixture_count DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Failure clusters by provenance

panels.description: Selected snapshot verification does not imply all historical archives are complete. history_complete and limitations are shown as stored.

targets.rawSql: SELECT import_id,import_state,source_schema,uploaded_observations,mapped_observations,expected_observations,coverage,history_complete,completed_provenances,source_artifact,history_limitations,as_of FROM test262_reporting.v_catalogue_imports WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring}) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Import verification and history gaps
Master, build, pin and registration freshness
panels.description: Master is an hourly GitHub observation. NULL means unknown/stale monitoring. Exact execution fingerprint binds binaries, harness and environment; empty evidence is not conformance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT evidence_kind,registration_revision,observed_master_revision,matches_observed_master,registration_validation_coherent,validation_revision,upstream_pin,execution_identity_sha256,last_trusted_evidence_at,master_observed_at,as_of FROM test262_reporting.v_target_health WHERE repository_id IN (${repository:sqlstring})
